stories.title: RBI flags inflation risks from West Asia conflict, El Nino amid resilient economy
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India said that inflationary pressures could increase because of the ongoing conflict in West Asia and the anticipated effects of the El Nino weather phenomenon. It also observed that the Indian economy remains resilient despite these external risks.

stories.title: White House says Melania Trump secured ceasefire in Oleshky, Ukraine
stories.summary: The White House announced that former First Lady Melania Trump had “successfully secured” a localized cease‑fire between Russian and Ukrainian forces in the occupied city of Oleshky, slated to begin on 29 October. Both sides reportedly agreed to stop firing at 02:00 GMT on 27 October and to allow evacuation of residents and delivery of aid. Oleshky has been under Russian control since February 2022 and residents have faced severe shortages.
stories.why: The truce could enable humanitarian aid to reach civilians suffering from food, water and medicine shortages.

stories.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn
stories.summary: Mink farming will end in Denmark by August 2029 after the government decided to drop plans to pursue an exemption to an EU-wide ban on the practice. Denmark was once the largest producer of mink fur in the world, but the industry has declined due to global bans on fur farming, a decline in the fur trade and an earlier outbreak of a Covid strain in the nation's mink population.
